stem.en: A matrix transforms most vectors by both rotating and scaling them. What is special about an eigenvector?
stem.et: Maatriks teisendab enamikku vektoreid nii pöörates kui ka skaleerides. Mis on omavektori juures erilist?

label.en: The matrix only scales it — its direction is unchanged, possibly reversed
label.et: Maatriks ainult skaleerib seda — selle suund ei muutu, võimalik, et pöördub vastupidiseks

label.en: Nothing — every vector the matrix acts on is an eigenvector
label.et: Mitte midagi — iga vektor, millele maatriks mõjub, on omavektor

label.en: It is rotated by exactly 90 degrees
Its length is always preserved exactly
